name: Seppa
description: District headquarters of East Kameng, situated on the banks of the Kameng River at about 363 m elevation. Scenic valley town with riverside views, local Nyishi markets, and a base for exploring the three valleys and nearby hill stations. Formerly known as Sepla meaning marshy land.
facts: Helipad in the heart of town

name: Bomdila
description: District headquarters of West Kameng at about 2415 m elevation. Scenic hill town with apple orchards, Buddhist monasteries (GRL), views of snow peaks, and base for exploring the Kameng valley and routes to Tawang.
facts: Known for GRL Monastery and apple orchards

name: Dirang
description: Town on NH-13 in West Kameng at about 1620 m, known for Monpa culture, Dirang Dzong, hot springs, and base for Sangti Valley and Mandala Top. Proposed first geothermal-powered town in India.
facts: Dirang Dzong and hot springs nearby

name: Sangti Valley
description: Scenic high-altitude valley about 14 km from Dirang, known as wintering ground for endangered black-necked cranes. Lush meadows, river, orchards, and traditional Monpa settlements; popular for birdwatching and photography.
facts: Best November to February for cranes

name: Thembang Fortified Village (Dzong)
description: Ancient Monpa fortified village with traditional Dzong architecture, on UNESCO tentative World Heritage list since 2014. Stone walls, two gates, living community with homestays; high historical and cultural significance.

name: Eaglenest Wildlife Sanctuary
description: Protected area of about 218 sq km in West Kameng, elevation 500-3250 m, famous for bird diversity including Bugun liocichla. Conjoins Sessa Orchid Sanctuary; part of Kameng Elephant Reserve.

name: Sessa Orchid Sanctuary
description: 100 sq km protected area in West Kameng dedicated to orchid conservation, adjoining Eaglenest. Home to hundreds of orchid species in subtropical to temperate forests.
facts: Part of Kameng Protected Area Complex

name: Tippi Orchid Research Centre
description: Orchid research and conservation centre at Tippi near Bhalukpong, with glass houses, museum, herbarium displaying thousands of orchid species. On the west bank of Kameng River.
facts: Large orchid collection and glass house

name: Nyukmadong War Memorial
description: War memorial near Nyukmadong on the Bomdila-Tawang highway commemorating the 1962 Battle of Nyukmadong. Features a chorten and plaques for fallen soldiers; scenic overlook.

name: Bhalukpong
description: Gateway town to Arunachal from Assam in West Kameng, on Kameng River at low elevation. Inner Line Permit check post, base for rafting, angling, and access to Tippi and higher hills.

name: Mandala Top
description: High ridge near Dirang with a circle of 108 Buddhist stupas (manes) built in 2018, offering panoramic views. Popular for birdwatching and as an offbeat viewpoint.

name: Chillipam Monastery
description: Buddhist monastery near Rupa in West Kameng, built on a promontory with 270-degree views of valleys. Features traditional art and murals; also known as Sangngag Choekhor Dargyeling.
